rinCaseStudy.title: RIN Aesthetic Practice
rinCaseStudy.subhead: A calm, fast website for a medical aesthetics studio in Charlottesville, built to turn first-time visitors into booked consultations.

meta.label: Services
meta.value: Brand-aligned UI, web development, booking integration

overview: RIN Aesthetic Practice offers medical aesthetics treatments in Charlottesville, Virginia. The practice needed a website that matched its refined, intentional, natural positioning, made its treatments easy to understand, and let prospective clients book a consultation without a phone call.
We designed and built the site from the ground up: brand-aligned interface, treatment and concern pages, a results gallery, a small shop, and online booking, all tuned for speed and accessibility.

built.label: Treatment and concern pages
built.text: Content organized by what a visitor is trying to solve, not only by procedure name.

built.label: Online booking
built.text: Consultation requests flow straight to the practice, with no third-party widget.

built.label: Results gallery
built.text: A lightweight gallery that loads fast on mobile, where most visitors browse.

built.label: Shop
built.text: A simple product section for the skincare the practice carries.

built.label: Brand-aligned UI
built.text: Gold on dark walnut, matching the physical space, with large photography and generous spacing.

rinCaseStudy.design: The practice's interior sets the tone: dark walnut slats, warm lighting, and a gold logotype. We carried that into the site with a near-black palette, gold accents reserved for actions, and serif display type for headings. Everything else stays quiet so the photography and the booking buttons do the work.
